key_caveats: ATLAS 2609.37215 (Sep 2026) already uses Run 3 data and ISR+soft tau; its expected sensitivity closes the gap to the large-Delta m results, so a Phase-2 extension is a natural continuation rather than a conceptually new analysis; collaborations may have it in preparation (CMS review 2510.17971 says compressed staus get 'particular attention' and analyses are in preparation).
Projections are low-novelty products; value lies in Phase-2 low-pT tau_h trigger/ID assumptions, which are UNVERIFIED in public Phase-2 TDR numbers here.
Observed ATLAS combined result has 2.7 sigma local excess at m=90/40 GeV, making the corridor experimentally interesting but also meaning Run-3 full dataset may change the picture before HL-LHC.
Indirect coverage via chargino/neutralino-via-stau interpretations (CMS 1910.01185, ATLAS 2609.37215) is model-dependent and does not constrain pure direct stau.
ESPPU-2026 SUSY projection contents not fully verified; 'not found' is not proof of absence.
